plan_review.notes: Reviewer found the detection predicate was fatally wrong: it detected reset-to-ancestor, not took-our-side, so it missed the -s ours incident it was written for. Confirmed with a synthetic git repro before accepting, then rewrote and mutation-proved the predicate. Also dropped the global path allowlist (it would have exempted manifest.json, a confirmed victim), kept the guard un-gated by DOCS_ONLY, and fixed the CI checkout to fetch-depth 0 plus the PR head sha rather than the synthetic merge commit.

Found colleague-merged-older-main-tip shape that NO ancestry test can see. Repro-confirmed; fixed by content grading (mainBlob === side); mutation-proven.

Found an over-defensive mainBlob !== null guard let a discarded mainline DELETION grade warn. Fix correct (isDiscarded already guarantees side !== base). Its supplied regression test was TAUTOLOGICAL - caught by mutation testing and rebuilt.

Severity grading declared CLEAN by systematic null/ancestry case table; no fourth shape and no false-error path. One finding: round-1 regression test was tautological (colleague merged mains tip so the content rule fired independently). Confirmed by mutation, fixture rebuilt so ancestry clause (b) is the only path to error, re-mutation-proven. All three severity tests now individually mutation-proven.
